_comment: Asia tradeable instruments + confluence references. Primary = 2 HK index futures (MHI, MTW) + 3 most-liquid HK single-stock options (Tencent, Alibaba, Xiaomi). Index futures for broad/sector exposure; single stocks for daily-liquid name-specific plays. Reference = independent signals (never traded).

hk_equivalent.trade: HSI (index options) + Tencent (700), Alibaba (9988), Xiaomi (1810) (single stocks)
hk_equivalent.correlate: A50, CSI300, VHSI, KWEB (most important for single-stock china tech overnight), SPX

_mental_model._dropped_2026-05-18: MHI (Mini-HSI options): only monthly expiries at IBKR, no weeklies — replaced by HSI for weekly cadence. MTW (Mini-HSTECH options): does not exist as a HK product at IBKR ('MTW' globally resolves to Manitowoc Company NYSE stock). HSTECH exposure now covered by single-stock basket Tencent+Alibaba+Xiaomi (~17% of HSTECH weight).

primary._comment: TRADE AND ANALYZE on these. HSI for broad index exposure + 3 single-stock options chains for name-specific plays. Add a new instrument by dropping an entry here matching this schema — scripts and dashboard auto-iterate.

HSI.name: Hang Seng Index Options
HSI.notes: HK broad index options. HK$50 per index point (5x Mini-HSI). Weekly Friday expiries + monthly cycle — verified 2026-05-18 via TWS contract search (May 22 Fri / May 28 / May 29 Fri / monthlies). OPT on HSI INDEX (NOT FOP on MHI futures — that was the wrong path tried earlier). Worst-case trail loss at default 5.0 HKD × 50 mult = 250 HKD/contract (~$32 USD).

TENCENT.name: Tencent Holdings
TENCENT.notes: Most liquid HK single-stock options chain (AAPL-tier). ~10% weight in HSTECH. Diversified business: gaming + WeChat + payments + cloud + AI investments. Weeklies trade Wednesdays.

ALIBABA.name: Alibaba Group
ALIBABA.notes: 2nd most liquid HK options chain. E-commerce + cloud + AI focus. Higher beta than Tencent (~1.5). Frequently diverges from Tencent — when they split, that's a real signal. Options trade under tradingClass=ALB with ×500 multiplier (verified 2026-05-18) — without explicit tradingClass, reqContractDetails returns 0 results.

XIAOMI.name: Xiaomi Corporation
XIAOMI.notes: Smartphones + IoT + EV (SU7). ~5% weight in HSTECH. Different driver mix than Tencent/Alibaba. Options trade under tradingClass=MIU with ×1000 multiplier (verified 2026-05-18) — larger multiplier than Tencent/Alibaba reflects Xiaomi's lower share price (~30 HKD vs 130-460), so contract notional stays in a comparable range.

reference._comment: CONFLUENCE / GATE signals — read these to gate or confirm setups. Independent of the primary instruments. Never traded. KWEB is the most important overnight tell for China-tech single-stock plays.

A50.name: China A50 Index Futures
A50.purpose: HK direction lead via mainland-exposed Singapore futures

CSI300.name: CSI 300 Index
CSI300.purpose: Mainland China leading indicator. Capital-controlled, different flow.

VHSI.name: HSI Volatility Index
VHSI.purpose: Vol regime gate (skip if >35 or <15). Even with single-stock trades, HSI vol regime drives single-name vol too.

KWEB.name: KraneShares CSI China Internet ETF (US-listed)
KWEB.purpose: Overnight US-session handover tell. Tencent/Alibaba ADRs are major KWEB holdings — when KWEB closes strong/weak in US session, it telegraphs HK open direction. MOST IMPORTANT reference for this playbook.

SPX.name: S&P 500 Index (cash)
SPX.purpose: Broad global risk handover. Sets tone going into HK open.
